limitations: All grades are provisional browser assessments based on the attached pixels and supplied runtime report; I did not independently execute its tests.
Related transition and scale variants are grouped with their settled state; visible overflow beyond a screenshot is not treated as proof of an unreachable control.
The supplied browser evidence supports keyboard, contrast, reduced-motion, persistence, recovery and timing judgments, but axe alone does not establish complete assistive-technology usability.
Physical iPhone/VoiceOver, native keyboard, tilt, haptics, native voice, actual OS sharing, notifications and native performance remain deferred without deductions solely for that boundary.
Filmstrips were inspected as chronological still sequences, not as video; frame-rate conclusions rely only on the separately reported browser measurements.
Crossfades demonstrate room-image transitions, but independent painted-layer parallax and continuous three-dimensional camera travel are not established.
Connected social behavior is not demonstrated, billing is simulated, and synthetic layout readings establish neither model quality nor predictive accuracy.
No hard-gate failure is established by the supplied evidence; several browser typography, hierarchy and surface scores nevertheless remain below the authorized A>=9 and F>=9 threshold.
Browser scores of 9 or higher do not certify full native 9/10 quality or repeated novice-use outcomes.
topFixes: Compact enlarged forecast and check-in cards so choices, status and actions require less scrolling while preserving complete centered text.
Improve dense centered explanations with clearer passage headings, group spacing and publisher/title/date hierarchy.
Rework the 200% Sky selector so theme labels fit comfortably inside its illustrated surface.
Reduce double-exposed room architecture during crossfades and improve grounding for floating reveal orbs and parchment overlays.
Shorten expanded disclosure, omen-policy and form-helper blocks; keep their primary task immediately apparent.
Contain the clipboard-fallback URL more compactly while preserving full selection and explicit failure recovery.
